notes.title: Demo version revised and updated & new releases two days in a row!
notes.notes:
[h3]Updated the demo version.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a link to the new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3412110/_/]“Severed Love”[/url] to Astter's PR links.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Mac version that froze when returning to the game after opening the link.
[*] Fixed broken links due to the official site relocation.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1567850/Primula/

And developer Zakurosuke's new work will be released on two consecutive days during a major holiday in Japan!


[h1]【Full voice demo version of the new game “Severed Love” is available for a limited time!】[/h1]
[previewyoutube=0jS-B4yhlVQ;full][/previewyoutube]
You have lost both your legs and arms and you can’t remember anything...
The Limb-Severing Devil's Confinement and Devotion.
Your only way to survive... Pretend to be his lover,

〈Live2D × PARANORMASIGHT-like × Psycho-Horror Romance Adventure〉

In conjunction with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/MGN2025]MGN2025 Indie Game Carnival[/url] on the Steam event page, a full-voice demo version is now available for a limited time!


[h2]【Distribution Period】[/h2]
[h3]Wednesday, April 30 - Wednesday, May 7, 2025[/h3]

The “life of confinement and care” with the killer who cut off your limbs is spun with full Live2D animation, 360-degree panoramic exploration, and stereophonic full voices.

Subscribe to our wish list and enjoy it with “Primula”!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3412110/_/


[h1]【The Chinese version of “Romp of Dump” will also be released continuously!】[/h1]
[previewyoutube=Xd49IPKB4ZM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Romp of Dump, a visual novel about the observation of a scum prisoners, will also be available for free in Simplified & Traditional Chinese versions tomorrow, May 1 (Thu.)![/h3]

In a prison called a dump, a betting card game among dangerous prisoners begins.
Penalty game for the losers!
Uncover the hidden pasts and bizarre crimes of these lunatics!

Of course, you can play the Japanese and English versions for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951520/Romp_of_Dump/


[h1]Thank you for the 4th anniversary of Primula![/h1]
I hope you enjoy it along with our new game!

notes.title: Demo Version Update! English version is now available!
notes.notes:
[h2]On 4/23/2024, "Primula" celebrated the third anniversary of the release of the demo version![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275439/ba6e30efa5ef825b2629dbf285f8daaf8e55f149.png[/img]
[h3]To commemorate this occasion, we have released an English version of the demo version![/h3]
I hope that this will be an opportunity for you to enjoy "Primula" as much as we do for everyone overseas.


[h1]【"Primula" x "Romp of Dump" collaboration event!】[/h1]
[h3]Zakurobento's new "Romp of Dump" also launched a collaborative event to celebrate the second anniversary of the release of the demo version![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951520/Romp_of_Dump/

After clearing the "Primula" demo version, you will be able to see the keyword in Extra mode.
If you enter the keyword in the "Romp of Dump", you will receive a collaboration item related to "Primula".

Present the collaboration item to a scum prisoners in "Romp of Dump" to see an exclusive episode.

[previewyoutube=rs0PV80Vw9I;full][/previewyoutube]
"Romp of Dump" is available for free. The episodes will be serialized with updates.
Why not take this opportunity to step into a prison full of lunatics called "Dump"......?


[h1]【Steam Achievements have been implemented!】[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275439/be3c741c7c923a17797c9a77560ca68e446a8db0.png[/img]
I have implemented Steam Achievements for those who started playing the game through the collaboration event and for those who wish to revisit the story of Primula.

If you have already cleared the trial version, you can unlock the achievements by restarting the scenario from the chapter selection.
The keywords for the collaboration event can also be checked immediately if you have already cleared the trial version.


[h1]【Update Details】[/h1]
[list]
[*] English version of the scenario has been implemented.
[*] Steam Achievements have been implemented.
[*] A keyword to play the collaboration event in the new "Romp of Dump" has been implemented.
[*] Other minor bugs and typos have been fixed.
[/list]
